Row.Text: Feudalism
The lord fortifies every seat of his realm. Have Medieval Walls in all your Cities.
Walls over every city hasten Feudalism — a share of its research is already complete.
Guilds
The market thrives where the water meets the road. Build a Bazaar with an adjacency bonus of 5 or more.
A well-sited Bazaar hastens Guilds — a share of its research is already complete.
Castles
One town gives up its trade for its walls. Have a Fort Town.
Your Fort Town hastens Castles — a share of its research is already complete.
Heraldry
Horse and banner ride together. Train 3 Cavalry units this Age. Any Cavalry unit counts, including unique ones.
3 Cavalry units hasten Heraldry — a share of its research is already complete.
Education
Scholars must be kept, not merely housed. Have a Specialist on an Observatory tile in 3 settlements.
Specialists at 3 Observatories hasten Education — a share of its research is already complete.
Metallurgy
The bow of steel and yew. Train 3 Crossbowmen this Age. Your civilization’s unique replacement counts.
3 Crossbowmen hasten Metallurgy — a share of its research is already complete.
Shipbuilding
Hulls are proven under fire. Defeat 5 units at sea this Age.
5 victories at sea hasten Shipbuilding — a share of its research is already complete.
Architecture
Fired clay becomes ornament. Build Kilns in 3 settlements.
Kilns in 3 settlements hasten Architecture — a share of its research is already complete.
Metal Casting
Armies need a trade behind them. Build Armorers in 2 settlements.
Armorers in 2 settlements hasten Metal Casting — a share of its research is already complete.
Gunpowder
War is carried to their country. Defeat 12 enemy units in their own territory this Age.
A campaign of 12 victories on enemy soil hastens Gunpowder — a share of its research is already complete.
Urban Planning
New ground is raised into cities. Have 2 Cities founded this Age.
2 Cities founded this Age hasten Urban Planning — a share of its research is already complete.
Reformation
The faith needs a house in every quarter. Build Temples in 3 settlements.
Temples in 3 settlements hasten Reformation — a share of its research is already complete.
Authority
Vassals answer the call to arms. Levy 2 units from City-States this Age.
A levied company hastens Authority — a share of its research is already complete.
Inspiration
The devout gather what the saints left behind. Earn 2 Relics.
2 Relics hasten Inspiration — a share of its research is already complete.
Mercantilism
Wealth follows the agreements of princes. Take part in 2 Endeavors with another civilization this Age.
2 Endeavors hasten Mercantilism — a share of its research is already complete.
Bureaucracy
Business between states needs an address. Build a Minor Embassy.
Your Minor Embassy hastens Bureaucracy — a share of its research is already complete.
Colonialism
One road carries a kingdom's goods. Have a Trade Route carrying 7 Resources.
A Trade Route of 7 Resources hastens Colonialism — a share of its research is already complete.
Diplomatic Service
Friendship is written down and signed. Form 2 Alliances this Age.
2 Alliances hasten Diplomatic Service — a share of its research is already complete.
Society
Hands are moved from the field to the trade. Place 10 Specialists this Age.
10 Specialists hasten Society — a share of its research is already complete.
Imperialism
A rival throne is taken. Capture a Capital this Age.
A captured Capital hastens Imperialism — a share of its research is already complete.
Social Class
The common house is the heart of the town. Build Taverns in 4 settlements.
Taverns in 4 settlements hasten Social Class — a share of its research is already complete.
Sovereignty
One creed answers to one crown. Have 10 settlements following your Religion.
10 settlements of your faith hasten Sovereignty — a share of its research is already complete.
